question: Which of the source's 23 specified synthetic generators reproduce the observed LP2 summary statistics when applied to the same 2979-rune solved plaintext?

extension_declared_before_scoring.name: 29-offset calibration of the source's c_i=c_(i-1)+p_i+1 row
extension_declared_before_scoring.scope: Use the same solved plaintext and compare all additive constants b=0..28 in c_i=c_(i-1)+p_i+b mod29. This follows up the source's selected b=1 after observing its near match, so it is descriptive, not a preregistered significance test.
extension_declared_before_scoring.identity: For i>0, c_i=c_(i-1) exactly when p_i=-b mod29. The count is therefore the plaintext frequency of rune -b after the first position.
extension_declared_before_scoring.comparison: Absolute difference between each synthetic adjacent-equal rate and the observed LP2 adjacent-equal rate; report the complete 29-row ledger and rank of b=1.

exclusions: No attempt to recover LP2 plaintext from any generator.
No general rejection of Vigenere, autokey, running keys, or chain ciphers from one plaintext sample.
The source's chi-square target is scaled by the sample-length ratio; do not interpret that scaled value as a chi-square significance comparison.
